name: Steal An Egg
primary_evidence: evidence_live_sae_2026-10-18.json (OBSERVED, HIGH) + public sources SRC-006..SRC-008, SRC-016

description_and_purpose.text: Steal eggs from wild pets and from other players, grow and hatch them, place the hatched pets at your base to earn money/s, train Speed on treadmills, and chase rarer pets, sizes and mutations.

tutorial.value: GuardTutorialSteps module + GuardTutorialPresentation controller exist (teaches the guard threat). OnboardingQuestlineFlags module exists but content NOT read.

new_player_experience.value: Starter gear is fixed: 1 bat + 3 traps (GameplayBalance.StarterGear). NewPlayerFlags module exists (unread). NewPlayer GRADUATED_SPEED_MULTIPLIER=2.5.

first_minutes_goals.value: Structural inference: Forest area (rank 1) + free tier-1 treadmill + 1,000-cost base level 1 = first goals are Forest egg steals and first base upgrade.

ui_and_hints.value: SmartProximityPrompt, HoverCard, ShopPreview, ShopNavigation, notifications; official description has a How-to-Play list.

early_barriers.value: No pity system found (unlike BSE). Guard threat is introduced via tutorial steps. Exact early friction NOT measured.

device_support.value: Desktop, Console, Mobile, Tablet officially stated; GamepadBindings/InputIconsConfig confirm gamepad support.

mapped_loop.ACTION: Steal an egg (from wild pet spawns in an area, and from other players' carried/placed eggs) — base Bat: 'Fling players and steal their eggs!'
mapped_loop.CHALLENGE: Area guardian chases (WalkSpeed 16 → 251, HitDistance 2.5 → 7, attack ragdoll 2.5s, knockback); carrying eggs SLOWS you up to 33% (less in later biomes); rivals can bat you and place traps that freeze you 7s
mapped_loop.REWARD: Egg grows in real time (per-pet GrowthTime, 10s → 18h) → hatch pet → place at base for EarningRate money/s; size bands and mutations multiply value
mapped_loop.PROGRESSION: Base upgrades 12 levels (1,000 → 5e15, capacity 7 → 19 pets), treadmills 12 tiers (0 → 7.5e15, x2 → x8,500), Speed curve, index completion unlocks bats
mapped_loop.NEXT_GOAL: Next area's drop table (rarity rank 1 → 12), the 13th index-bat, rare size bands (up to 35x) and mutations

B_core_loop.caveat: Every step is confirmed in config; the exact live pick-up/deposit sequence was not witnessed this pass (OBS-SAE pending).

repeated_activities.activity: Steal eggs with bats (fling players, snatch eggs)
Grow eggs in real time, hatch, place pets at base
Train speed on treadmill (per-second gain, tier multiplier)
Upgrade base (12 levels) and treadmill (12 tiers)
Complete area indexes to unlock stronger bats
Place traps / gravity disruptor to defend your eggs

why_loop_connects_to_next_goal.statement: Money and Speed are separate: money buys capacity (base) and throughput (treadmill), while Speed comes from treadmill time and gates nothing numeric in the area config — area access appears to be gated by INDEX completion rather than a stat threshold (INFERRED from bat/index wording; the actual gate is UNKNOWN).

movement_traversal.value: Walk-speed curve: base 10 → reference max 400, XP growth 1.15, +2 speed/level, treadmill gain interval 1s; carrying eggs applies 0–33% slowdown (per-biome cap); MountRace/PetMount systems exist.

combat_or_primary_interaction.value: Bats: 13 index-gated tiers, force 35 → 99.86, range bonus 0 → 20.63, duration 0.5 → 1.43s; client cooldown 0.6s / server 0.7s. Slap tools (The Scrambler, Flyswatter, Cricket's Banjo).

egg_pet_collectible.value: 263 pet entries with EarningRate (180/s → 1.8B/s sampled), real-time GrowthTime (10s → 64,800s), 11 weighted size SCALE_BANDS (0.1x → 35x, hard cap 150x), 18 rarity entries, 11 mutation variants.

npc_ai.value: 16 guard configs, one per area (+3 Light/Dark sub-biome guards). WalkSpeed 16 → 251.075, HitDistance 2.5 → 7, ragdoll 2.5s, knockback 20 horizontal/60 up, return-home timeout 20s, stuck timeout 10s, retrieval deposit radius 20, some guards have EggPickupDistance 18 (they carry eggs themselves).
npc_ai.note: Guards ALSO retrieve/deposit eggs — they are not only chasers. Exact behaviour not witnessed live.

stealing_pvp.value: Theft is the headline verb (official + bat description). Explicit COUNTER-PLAY exists: Trap/BigTrap (freeze 7s, 3 max), GravityDisruptor (slow 50%, 3 max), BeeLauncher (invert controls, 5s, cd 58s). Starter kit includes 3 traps.
stealing_pvp.note: Closes the long-standing 'defensive counter-play in SAE' gap.

inventory_equipment.value: Base capacity 7 → 19 (12 levels); MAX_PLACED_EGGS=30; 3 fusion inputs; gear slots for bats/traps/tools; EggInventory + InventoryFlags.

upgrade_stat_progression.value: Two sinks: base (12 levels, capacity) and treadmill (12 tiers, multiplier). Plus index completion (unlocks bats + IndexSpeedReward).

zones_unlock.value: 13 areas with rarity ranks 1–12 + a Light/Dark split with 3 sub-biomes. No numeric speed gate found in the Areas config — access rule UNKNOWN (index-completion is INFERRED, not proven).

quests_missions_achievements.value: Area indexes per area (unlock bats, grant IndexSpeedReward); Wisp Quests; Roblox badges (Hatched Eternal/Divine/Secret, Got Divine Trail, Got Angelic Treadmill); Boss Mastery; Scramble Mastery.

multiplayer.value: Shared servers; bats + traps + gravity disruptor + bee launcher; FriendsInServer tracking; group reward gated to accounts ≥5 days old; content-creator remotes; rewarded-video billboards.

trading_economy_between_players.value: Gifting module + Giftable products exist; ScrambleTradeIn (event trade-in). No pet-to-pet trading observed.

failure_penalty.value: Guard attack → ragdoll 2.5s + knockback (20h/60v, home multiplier 5). Trap → freeze 7s. BeeLauncher → inverted controls 5s. Dropped eggs abandoned after 75s or 200 studs away. Guard attack interval 0.75s; pinned-hit delay 0.5s.

events_limited_content.value: Very dense: Halloween Dimension (live), Train event, Capture the Egg, Demonic event, Dragon race, Light vs Darkness, Sakura/Great Bloom, Shrine Fusion, Beanstalk, Sammy, Monster parasite, Rift, Scramble boss/trade-in, Mount Race, Race Rally, Cursed Island Wars, Fishing, Banjo Cricket, Shooting Star, Trex Run, Red Light Green Light, Boss shop/mastery, Pet Wheel, Wisp Quests, Star Handler.

daily_offline_rewards.value: OfflineFlags module exists but ERRORED on require — offline reward system EXISTS, values UNKNOWN. CashPacks refresh on real-time windows (40min → 48h) as a return hook.

gamepasses_products.value: 3 gamepasses (x2 Money, x2 Growth, Lucky) + 127 product entries: money packs, +1M speed, treadmill-speed time offers (5min–4h), permanent/temporary speed boosts, paid SERVER-WIDE luck x4/x8, 9 Instant Hatch tiers (15min–10h), all 12 treadmills, trails, limited-egg packs, double trophies, rewarded-video ads, legacy 'DNA stealing no longer available' products.

timed_systems.value: Egg growth timers (10s → 18h per pet), Instant Hatch skip ladder, potion-style luck boosts (900s), event preparation/fight windows, cash-pack refresh windows.

codes.value: No code-redemption remote observed; absence NOT proven.

D_progression_economy.prices_captured: 12 base levels (1,000 → 5e15), 12 treadmill tiers (0 → 7.5e15), trap 1,000, BeeLauncher 10,000
D_progression_economy.reward_values_captured: pet EarningRate samples (180/s → 1.8B/s of 263 entries), IndexSpeedReward per pet, area drop-table weights

summary.rarities: 18 entries (ranks 1–12 with duplicates: Rainbow/BrainrotGod share rank 6)
summary.mutations: 11 variants: Scrambled, Golden, Rainbow, Silver, Sakura, GreatBloom, Boss, Enchanted, Nitro, Spectral, Monstrous

conflict.claim: Third-party guides described SAE as having NO guard/NPC defence and NO player-combat tools
conflict.resolution: The earlier UNKNOWN was correct to be unknown; live data supersedes. Guides were simply incomplete.

player_influence.value: Theft of eggs (core verb), bat flinging (13 tiers), freeze traps, gravity slow, control-inverting bees, gifting. Paid luck boosts affect the whole server.

competition_vs_cooperation.value: Competition is primary (theft + tools), but SAE has genuine cooperative monetization: ServerLuck x4/x8 benefits everyone for 900s. Group reward requires account age ≥5 days.

risk_strategy.value: Explicit and quantified: carrying eggs slows you up to 33% (less in late biomes), so long carries are slower and more exposed; traps cost money to place (1,000) and cap at 3; dropped eggs expire in 75s.

griefing_risk.value: Real: bats + BeeLauncher (control inversion) + traps. Mitigations: freeze capped at 7s and 3 instances, guard threat is shared, late-biome carry penalty is lower. Severity NOT observed.

why_play_with_friends.value: FriendsInServer is tracked as an attribute; friend-boost effect NOT read.

systems_actually_present.system: Egg growth timers (real time, up to 18h)
Area indexes with completion rewards (bats + speed)
Boss tokens/mastery, Sakura crystals, trophies/races as parallel collections

short_term_goals.goal: Steal → grow → hatch → place → first base upgrade

mid_long_term_goals.goal: 12 base levels, 12 treadmills, 13 index-bats, rare size bands, event collections

reward_frequency.value: Money ticks every second from placed pets; egg growth is slow (minutes→hours) — a fast-income/slow-cadence split

monotony_risk.point: Unlike BSE, SAE varies verbs heavily (fishing, races, fusion, quests, 20+ events) — structural monotony risk looks LOWER than BSE, but this is a structural comparison, not a measured one.

likely_frustration.point: Egg growth timers up to 18h with Robux skips
Being repeatedly flung/trapped while carrying slowed eggs

sections_not_yet_checked: Area access rule (what unlocks a new area)
Offline reward values (module errored on require)
Robux prices (no purchase will be made)
Live witnessing of a theft, a guard catch, and a trap freeze
